{{Quote|Once the home of Emperor Palpatine, it now stood as a monument to his terrible reign. The remnants of the Imperial High Command had themselves holed up in the palace with the bulk of the Coruscant Defense Forces.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="GBCC" />}}
The '''Coruscant Defense Forces''' were the military forces tasked with defending the galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It consisted of various troops, vehicles and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] such as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Missile launcher trooper|anti-air troopers]], [[Dewback trooper/Legends|dewback troopers]], [[Phase II Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]], [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]], [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST walkers]], [[All Terrain Anti Aircraft/Legends|AT-AA walkers]], [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT walkers]], [[Imperial mobile artillery|mobile artillery]], [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1s]], and [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Coruscant Defense Forces were led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tal Ashen]] who personally commanded the [[Elite Force]], the unit defending the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]].<ref name="GBCC" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Coruscant Defense Forces were defeated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]].<ref name="GBCC" />
